description: Rename a thread, archive or unarchive it, lock or unlock it, or change its slowmode and auto-archive window.

archived.description: true archives the thread (it leaves the active list; a new message reopens it), false unarchives it.

auto_archive_minutes.description: Archive the thread after this long without messages: 60, 1440 (one day), 4320 (three days), or 10080 (a week).

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

locked.description: true stops members without Manage Threads from replying or unarchiving it; false lets them again.

slowmode_seconds.description: Seconds each member must wait between messages, up to 21600 (6 hours); 0 turns slowmode off.

name: update_thread
title: Update thread
